newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-LINEBACKER CROEL REUNITED WITH COACH REEVES IN ATLANTA.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-LINEBACKER CROEL REUNITED WITH COACH REEVES IN ATLANTA.

text.p: Unrestricted free agent linebacker Mike Croel Thursday agreed to a one-year contract with the Atlanta Falcons, reuniting him with coach Dan Reeves.
Croel, who started all 16 games at left outside linebacker last year for the Baltimore Ravens, played under Reeves with the Denver Broncos and New York Giants.

Croel, who turns 28 next month, was selected by Reeves with the fourth pick overall in the 1991 NFL draft. He made an instant impact for Denver with 10 sacks, four forced fumbles and a touchdown return to earn Rookie of the Year honours.

He played four seasons with Denver and signed as a free agent with the Giants in 1995 to play for Reeves. He played in all 16 games that year, but was released after the season and signed with the Ravens in 1996.
Croel joins a linebacking corps that features Cornelius Bennett, Jessie Tuggle and Ron George.
